# Exygy

> Exygy is a mission-driven B-Corp designing and building digital platforms that make government services and affordable housing more accessible and equitable.

With over 20 years of experience, Exygy specializes in civic technology solutions including CiviForm (a no-code platform for public benefits applications) and Bloom Housing (a comprehensive affordable housing application platform). The company is committed to social justice, equity, and open-source solutions in the public sector.

## Core Products & Solutions

- [CiviForm - Public Benefits](https://exygy.com/public-benefits): No-code platform enabling government agencies to streamline public benefits applications with accessibility and user-centered design
- [Bloom Housing - Affordable Housing](https://exygy.com/affordable-housing): Comprehensive housing portal platform simplifying affordable housing applications for residents and standardizing processes across jurisdictions

## Case Studies & Implementation

- [San Francisco DAHLIA Platform](https://exygy.com/case-studies/reimagining-the-affordable-housing-process-in-san-francisco): Redesigned affordable housing application platform serving San Francisco residents with improved user experience
- [Alameda County Common Application](https://exygy.com/case-studies/alameda-county-common-application): Bloom Housing implementation standardizing housing applications across Alameda County
- [City of Oakland Digital Redesign](https://exygy.com/case-studies/a-refreshed-digital-front-door-for-oakland): Complete digital front-door redesign for City of Oakland with accessibility and inclusive design focus
- [Bookshare Modernization](https://exygy.com/case-studies/expanding-equitable-access-to-knowledge-modernizing-bookshare-for-a-more-inclusive-future): Platform modernization expanding equitable access to digital content for inclusive audiences
- [Project Legal Link Accessibility](https://exygy.com/case-studies/making-legal-systems-accessible-to-non-lawyers): Redesign making legal systems more accessible to non-lawyers through simplified digital interfaces
- [Global Health Gender Equity](https://exygy.com/case-studies/supporting-gender-equity-integrating-in-global-health-movements): Integration of gender equity principles into global health initiatives and digital platforms
